label: The Wayfarer's Rest
description: Oakrun's inn: warm windows, a low slate roof, and a sign creaking above the door.

label: Basil's Cures
description: A neat village apothecary that looks reassuringly ordinary.

label: Oakrun General Goods
description: A compact village shop with a street-facing counter and a carefully limited selection.

label: Palace of Still Water
description: Drazna's surviving palace rises above three sealed sluice arches. Court windows look down on roofs the old flood order called empty.

label: Crown Sluice Gatehouse
description: Hoist towers and chain drums keep the inhabited wards above water. Every repair patch is newer than the Crown's claim that the lower works are sealed.

label: Drowned Bell Tower
description: Only the upper chamber remains above the quay. Its bell sounds at falling water although the visible rope was cut decades ago.

label: House of Names
description: A secular memorial archive built on the driest slope in Drazna. Public tablets face the road; disputed household rolls stay behind iron mesh.

label: The Eel and Ember
description: A low quay inn keeps its hearth above the oldest waterline and its back door above the newest smuggling route.
details: Cellar tally: more meals than beds

label: Walking Ward Bridge Houses
description: Homes and workshops have been lashed into one inhabited bridge above drowned streets. Repairs double as roads and every road passes someone's window.

label: Old Dry Dock Entrance
description: A retaining-wall arch opens only at falling water. Crown chalk stops at the lintel; red Low Lantern marks continue inside.

label: Birch Stair Memorial Arch
description: White birches grow from stone pockets above an arch engraved with the officially counted dead. Families have tied uncounted names to the branches.
